fato_historico: 1956: Hungarian Revolution: A new Hungarian government is formed, in which many members of banned non-Communist parties participate. János Kádár and Ferenc Münnich form a counter-government in Moscow as Soviet troops prepare for the final assault.

It is a good time to lead with your heart and embrace new beginnings with confidence.
frase_do_dia: The sun rises within you, casting light upon every path you choose to take.
